- TARGET cbdaefe5... (Platform team, "Fall Kickoff", September 15 – September 29)

Decoys:
- DECOY b30d471e (Mobile, "Fall Kickoff Retro", fact A:Cycle.name)
- DECOY cbc1556c (Growth, "Fall Kickoff", fact B:Issue.cycleId — Sam's checkout timeout issue there is Leo Park's, and Sam's issue is the onboarding checklist)

So this is an underspecified test: two cycles (WEB #14 and PLA #5) fully satisfy the request: both named "Fall Kickoff" and both contain a checkout timeout issue assigned to Sam Rivera (WEB-1 and PLA-1 respectively).
